scope: One predeclared development repair on a licensed family new to the project evidence. Ordinary installed Finish gaps with preserved original copper, no model use.

source.previous_evidence_lookup: No match for the repository, revision, board digest or connector family in tracked evidence and bounded retained intake metadata. One candidate advanced to the actual workflow.

frozen_task.routing_profile: corrected Standard Finish gaps, all source copper and default via preference

admission_limit: The frozen intake counted KiCad error severity and the intended open. It did not screen the existing field warning against Copperpath's stricter routing acceptance policy.

actual.acceptance_refusal: KiCad reported the inherited footprint/schematic Datasheet mismatch (PCB '~', schematic empty). Copperpath treats this warning class as critical. The result also missed the frozen one-net usefulness rule by adding routes on five completed nets.

measurement.time_scope: The observed elapsed interval includes the accessibility driver's wait for a success control that correctly stayed unavailable and the later explicit refusal read. The independent worker and admission times remain separate. There was no review acceptance or export time on this failed trial.
measurement.product_friction: An original parity warning stopped acceptance only after routing. The visible summary used an internal finding key. Finish gaps also added copper to completed nets.
measurement.automation_friction: The driver timed out waiting for Review result after the application had already refused the candidate. A separate visible-state read confirmed the refusal and disabled delivery. Timing was reconciled on the common recorded clock.

raw_evidence: The pinned project with its license, frozen task, Native inspection, failed GUI job, candidate and refusal screenshot are retained locally. No third-party CAD was committed.
